changes: Recognized catalogue aliases plus target-data indicators, SPARC MassModels and filesystem aliases refuse before metadata; complete symlink expansion including remaining suffix is screened before target metadata.
Output parent traversal and symlink components refuse; descriptor-relative exclusive directory and fixed-file creation uses O_NOFOLLOW, O_DIRECTORY and O_EXCL with entry identity checks.
Bounded iterative scan and controlled RecursionError produce exit2 without traceback.

Narrow compatibility adapter read_coordinates requires the exact selected coordinate source path and byte hash. Only the two exact observation-region provenance strings at observation_region.path and inputs_pinned.observation_region.path are inert during screening; the original coordinate object is returned unchanged. This is not authorization to dereference either string.

tested_scope.builder: 85 exact-source controls on invented fixtures; metadata spies; real owned symlinks/output collisions/flags; simulated namespace races; actual main() deep-input refusal; unchanged scientific helper AST; synthetic coordinate pin/position mutations.
tested_scope.independent: 75 controls including actual exact selected coordinate view and writer to selected actual filler compatibility; original coordinate object preserved; changed pin/path/bytes/positions refuse; actual referenced data path raw/safe_path attempts refuse before any IO.

preserved_failure: v009 passed its narrow builder controls but independent actual selected-coordinate integration refused two inert provenance strings. The source and failed compatibility evidence remain preserved; v010 is the supported successor.
limits: The lexical screen is bounded to recognized aliases and indicators, not exhaustive renamed/unknown-content detection. Unknown filesystem aliases and hard-linked content are outside this fix.
Input symlink reads remain permitted and are not a fully descriptor-locked hostile-race sandbox. Output symlink ancestors are rejected even where permitted for reads.

Output publication is not atomic across three files. Partial new outputs remain on failure; retries require a new directory. A hostile actor able to rename parent directories can interrupt or move publication; no universal namespace-race immunity is claimed.
Output checks confine writes to the explicit requested new directory; they do not create an arbitrary hardcoded output-root policy.
Semantic review findings2/3/4 remain unchanged. No new producer semantics, scientific completion/admission claim, consumer contract, or root ruling.
Production scientific authentication and real launches remain UNTESTED. Synthetic compatibility is not scientific acceptance.
